knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says to acknowledge an extra request, check whether it is in scope, and obtain documented approval before changing the job.
A hazard or defect is handed over through the approved channel and recorded, and unfinished work is never marked complete.
The instruction says to confirm the service agreement, arrival window, access instructions and authorised scope before work.

practicalCriteria: Checks the site/task requirements before acting
Identifies and applies relevant safety and privacy controls
Communicates professionally and respects authorisation boundaries
Records the outcome and escalates unresolved issues correctly
passRule: All safety-critical criteria must be demonstrated; remediate and reassess any missed criterion.
evidenceRequired: Record of procedure step 3: On arrival, introduce yourself, verify the correct property and explain the planned service.
Record of procedure step 4: Obtain consent before entering private rooms or moving possessions, and do not photograph personal items without permission.
Record of procedure step 5: Keep conversation professional, and do not promise extra services, prices or outcomes without authority.
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 2 is not done: Seek confirmation from the designated supervisor or client contact if any instruction is unclear, rather than guessing.
Stop work if procedure step 4 is not done: Obtain consent before entering private rooms or moving possessions, and do not photograph personal items without permission.
